short_description: Mid-range QLED with quantum dot color enhancement. Good HDR performance for the price; contrast limited by VA panel black levels.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: VA panel with quantum dot backlight enhancement. Contrast varies by model (3,000–6,000:1 typical); 4,500 used as midpoint estimate.

known_limitations: Black levels limited by LCD backlight bleed — contrast noticeably worse than OLED in a dark room
Full-screen HDR brightness drops to ~300 nits — peak figure applies only to small highlights
